levels.surface: الحسن بن محمد بن عبد الله بن عيسى

notes: Two rule-11 cases: Mansur's first-person account («دخلت على أبي الحسن») is a narrated encounter where the Imam speaks («فقال لي»); and the Imam is read as the last link under owner ruling 2. A ruling is needed.
«يعني موسى بن جعفر» is an editor gloss and is left out; the Imam is written as the report names him, أبي الحسن. Bare «أبي» and «أبيه» are relation links.
